note: This file is a pure configuration dictionary with no callable functions, classes, or methods. It defines MMDetection config overrides for a Mask R-CNN model using an HRNet v2-w32 backbone and HRFPN neck. No argparse-cli-callable code is present.
summarize_config: summarize the mask-rcnn hrnetv2p-w32 config file for the COCO dataset
review_backbone_config: review the HRNet backbone stage configuration for num_channels and num_blocks
review_neck_config: review the HRFPN neck configuration with in_channels and out_channels settings
review_base_config: review the base config reference to mask-rcnn_r50_fpn_1x_coco
review_init_cfg: review the pretrained checkpoint initialization config for hrnetv2_w32
